name: Szilsárkány (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Szilsárkány: a crowned blue shield with a yellow griffin holding a sabre, above a yellow scroll inscribed SZILSÁRKÁNY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Szilsárkány arms with crown and scroll
